characters.name: Sintel
characters.look: a young woman with short red hair; out in the snow, in a hooded fur-trimmed brown coat with a scarf over her face, carrying a long staff; otherwise in a grey tank top, brown trousers and boots, with bandaged forearms
characters.role: a lone traveller crossing the mountains in search of a dragon
characters.nameEvidence: Official subtitles (durian.blender.org/wp-content/content/subtitles/sintel_en.srt, cue 22, 00:07:37,800): the old man says "These are dragon lands, Sintel." at film 7:37.8, the first time her name is said (speech at 457.6–459.2 s on the 1080p download's centre channel). The "SINTEL" title card at 1:30–1:37 names the film, not the figure; end credit "Sintel — Halina Reijn" at 12:45.

characters.name: Shaman
characters.look: an old man with a grey beard, a red stripe of face paint across his eyes and a beaded headband, in red-brown robes, holding a staff or a long pipe
characters.role: the old man who takes her into his tent and tends her by the fire
characters.nameEvidence: End credits only ("Shaman — Thom Hoffman" at film 12:48, after the story ends); never said in the dialogue or shown on him.

characters.name: Scales
characters.look: a small tan dragon with big round eyes, a knobbly, ridged head and broad leathery wings; when first found, a bleeding wing
characters.role: the baby dragon she finds wounded on a rooftop and nurses back to health
characters.nameEvidence: Official subtitles (sintel_en.srt, cue 15, 00:03:48,250): she says "Good night, Scales." to the small dragon at film 3:48.3, the first time the name is said (speech at 227.8–228.8 s on the 1080p centre channel); then "Get him, Scales! Come on!" at 4:10.4.

unnamedIn.reason: The horned dragon's swoop at sunset (film 5:15–5:31, shots 71–75): the grown horned dragon dives through the clouds over the ruins and seizes the small dragon above her reaching hand. Both are tan dragons, so the look cannot tell them apart; the describer called the horned dragon "the small tan dragon, Scales" (shot 72, voiced 5:22.3) and the clutched pair "Scales" (shot 75, voiced 5:29.6).

The cave (film 8:04–11:24, from its mouth to the ledge): the only dragons there are the baby dragon in the lair (8:46–9:09; shot 127 at 9:07.1 was described as "The small tan dragon, Scales") and the grey dragon she calls "Scales?" (10:21.6) and "Scales..." (10:26.2), both labels under decision 0012.

The ending (film 12:04–12:25, shots 168–170, up to the credits): the baby dragon from the lair lies on the rocks behind her as she walks away; described as "The small tan dragon, Scales" (voiced 12:10.8) and "Scales" (voiced 12:18.1).

characters.name: the bald man
characters.look: a bald, heavy-set man with a drooping black moustache, in a padded leather tunic
characters.role: a man who attacks her in the snow and wrestles her for her staff
characters.nameEvidence: A label, not a name: never named in the dialogue or the credits (film 0:42–1:10).

characters.name: the horned dragon
characters.look: a full-grown tan-brown dragon with curled ram's horns and vast leathery wings
characters.role: a grown dragon that swoops over the rooftops at sunset and carries the small dragon away
characters.nameEvidence: A label, not a name: never named in the dialogue or the credits (film 5:15–5:30).

characters.name: the grey dragon
characters.look: a huge dark grey dragon with a heavy, knobbly scaled head, dark eyes and torn wings
characters.role: the great dragon in the moonlit cave, who fights her
characters.nameEvidence: A label: never named in the credits. She says "Scales?" (sintel_en.srt cue 25, film 10:21.6) and "Scales..." (cue 26, 10:26.2) to it as it lies still; it stays a label here so the name Scales stays bound to the small tan dragon's look (decision 0012).

characters.name: the baby dragon in the lair
characters.look: a small pale dragon curled up asleep in the dark cave, its wings folded
characters.short: the baby dragon in the cave
characters.role: a young dragon she finds in the cave
characters.nameEvidence: A label: never named in the credits. She cries "Scales!" (sintel_en.srt cue 24, film 9:17.6) while it is in view; the film does not confirm a name for it, so none is given (film 8:50–9:00, 12:08–12:20).
